verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows llama.cpp ships a server (`llama serve`) and GBNF grammar-constrained generation. Grammars are an adjacent building block, not native tool-calling. No item documents tool or function-calling support or a reasoning-content parser in server requests, so this applicable serving-API story gets no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests
